ITEM 1 | Halved cherry tomatoes, bright red with glossy skin and pale green stem ends, cut faces showing seeds and juicy pulp, clustered in a loose heap on the upper left of the plate, roughly 8 cm across | 90
ITEM 2 | Cubed roasted potato pieces, pale golden-yellow with browned edges and a dry, slightly crisp surface, mixed with flecks of chopped green herb, roughly 2 cm cubes forming a mound about 7 cm across in the lower left | 110
ITEM 3 | Sliced mushrooms and small pale onion pieces, tan-brown with soft, slightly glossy texture, scattered among the potatoes and tucked against the fish-like slab | 35
ITEM 4 | Rectangular baked portion, golden-orange crust with darker brown spots and a creamy, slightly glossy top sauce, layered with greenish and dark flecks, dense and firm, about 9 cm long by 4 cm wide and 2.5 cm tall, sitting on the right side of the plate | 160
ITEM 5 | Smaller piece of the same baked item, pale golden with lighter creamy surface and a softer, moister edge, about 4 cm by 3 cm, positioned beside the larger portion on the right | 45
